Amit Khatri

9422364421 | amitrkhatri@gmail.com | 

Professional Summary

Product Owner and Senior Business Analyst with over 18 years of experience delivering digital transformation, system integrations, and end-to-end solutions across financial services, capital markets, regulatory, and government sectors. I bring strong expertise in requirements elicitation, process modeling, stakeholder engagement, and Agile delivery frameworks, including Scrum and SAFe . Experienced in facilitating discovery workshops, documenting As-Is and To-Be workflows, and translating complex operational processes into structured requirements and automation initiatives. Having led projects across Australia, Europe, Singapore, Dubai, and India, I excel at bridging business and technology to deliver scalable solutions that improve operational efficiency and drive long-term business value.

Key Clients

Citibank, Barclays, Bank of America, Societe Generale, Deutsche Bank, Nippon Mutual Fund

Certifications

Business Analysis Certification – BCS / IIBA, The Chartered Institute for IT

Certified SAFe® Product Owner / Product Manager (Version 6.0) – Scaled Agile, Inc.

Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) – Scrum Alliance

ISO 20022, NPP, RTP, and SWIFT MX Messaging Certification – ICMI Learning Academy

Derivatives and Commodity Market Certification – NISM (Securities Operations and Risk Management)

Core Competencies & Skills

Business Analysis, Process Modeling, Agile Delivery (Scrum, SAFe),Requirements Elicitation Documentation, Stakeholder Engagement, Workshop Facilitation, User Stories & Acceptance Criteria, Gap Analysis, Risk Mitigation, Change Management, Product Backlog Management, Strategic Planning, Data Analysis, Technical Integration, Solution Evaluation, Regulatory Compliance, Jira, Confluence, Miro,Value Stream Mapping.

Technical Skills

FIX Protocol, SWIFT Net, ISO 20022, JIRA, Visio, SQL, Excel, Power BI, UML, BPMN, REST / Domain API, JSON, XML, Postman, CRM Systems, Kafka, Active MQ, Wire frame, Cloud (AWS), Android Applications, Service Now, BCP Disaster Recovery, Database Migration, SAP, SaaS, Google Analytic, Mobility Platforms, Machine Learning.

Professional Experience

FIS Global [Jun 2018 – Mar 2025]	Principal Business Analyst / Product Owner

FIS Global Leading financial technology provider delivering innovative solutions across banking, payments, and capital markets. Strong presence in Australia (Sydney, Melbourne), contributing to initiatives such as the New Payments Platform (NPP) and local payments services via Worldpay from FIS.

Led regulatory and platform integration enhancements across Middle and Back Office systems to support EMIR Refit compliance, aligning delivery with Agile product roadmaps.

Translated regulatory and business requirements into user stories, functional specifications, data mappings, and acceptance criteria for development and QA teams.

Facilitated cross-functional workshops with Finance, Operations, and Technology stakeholders to define integration requirements, system dependencies, and end-to-end trading workflows.

Designed and optimised end-to-end business process models (BPMN/Visio), identifying operational bottlenecks and improving data flow orchestration across trading, clearing, and settlement platforms.

Collaborated with vendors and technical teams to implement API and FIX integrations with exchanges including Australian Securities Exchange, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, London Metal Exchange, Singapore Exchange, Nasdaq, and Eurex, ensuring alignment with interface specifications and business rules.

Supported SEPA payment integration initiatives by analysing business requirements, documenting payment workflows, and validating end-to-end payment processing in line with ISO 20022 standards.

Collaborated with Product Owners, Operations, and Technology teams to support SEPA payment enhancements, user story creation, UAT, and reconciliation for payment processing solutions.

Contributed to Agile delivery practices, supporting sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release planning while mentoring junior Business Analysts on integration and process analysis practices.

Performed data analysis and reconciliation to support integration testing and regulatory reporting, presenting delivery progress, risks, and insights to senior stakeholders and steering committees.

Key Achievements

Delivered critical EMIR compliance updates ahead of regulatory deadlines.

Recognised with the “Lead with Integrity and Accountability” award for excellence in cross-regional delivery and stakeholder collaboration.

Accenture [Jul 2014 – Jun 2018]	Team Lead Business Analyst

Accenture is a global professional services company specialising in digital, cloud, and security solutions, with a strong presence across Australia (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Canberra, and Perth). It partners with clients in financial services, government, and energy sectors to drive digital transformation and innovation.

Partnered with Nippon Mutual Fund to elicit, document, and prioritise functional and non-functional requirements across multiple Agile initiatives.

Led end-to-end delivery of a B2B and B2C e-commerce portal and mobile onboarding solution, integrating REST APIs, digital KYC, payment gateway, and biometric authentication services.

Defined user roles, access controls, and data governance models within the Treasury Management System (TMS) to reduce operational risk and ensure regulatory compliance.

Facilitated stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs to validate business needs, map system dependencies, and align project objectives.

Authored detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation using Jira and Confluence, focusing on API integration requirements and data flows.

Developed current-state and future-state process models to identify bottlenecks and propose improvements aligned with customer experience and system interoperability.

Collaborated with UX/UI and security architects to ensure mobile applications adhered to user centric design principles and PCI DSS standards.

Partnered with third-party vendors (including FSS Payment Gateway) to define integration scope, manage REST API integrations, and oversee implementation.

Supported SEPA payment integration by analysing functional requirements, mapping payment workflows, and coordinating implementation with business and technology teams.

Performed impact analysis and UAT validation for SEPA and cross-border payment enhancements, ensuring seamless integration with Treasury Management System (TMS) and payment gateway platforms.

Key Achievements

Awarded Certificate of Excellence by Reliance Nippon Mutual Fund for delivering innovative digital solutions across mobile and web platforms.

Received “Star of the Month” at Accenture for outstanding contributions to a high-impact digital transformation program.

Singapore Mercantile Exchange [Feb 2011 – Feb 2014]	Senior Associate BA

Singapore Mercantile Exchange (SMX) was Singapore’s first pan Asian commodity and derivatives exchange, providing multi asset trading across commodities, currencies, and indices under the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) framework. The exchange aimed to deliver a transparent, efficient, and unified marketplace for regional and global participants.

Led the configuration and implementation of a derivatives exchange trading platform, delivering core modules including Order Matching, Order Management, Surveillance & Risk Management, Clearing & Settlement, and Collateral Management.

Collaborated with cross-functional stakeholders across trading, operations, and technology teams to gather, validate, and document business requirements, producing detailed BRDs and FRDs aligned with business and regulatory objectives.

Conducted functional and system testing of trading workflows, including Start-of-Day and End-of-Day processes, validating FIX 4.4 connectivity, market data feeds, and platform interoperability.

Coordinated User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business SMEs and operations teams, managing defect tracking, prioritisation, and sign-off to ensure production readiness.

Managed production releases and deployment activities, supporting patch updates and ensuring stable transitions in high-availability trading environments.

Configured SAP BusinessObjects reporting solutions to support data warehouse analytics and regulatory reporting in compliance with requirements from Monetary Authority of Singapore.

Key Achievements

Successfully delivered the end to end implementation and golive of SMX, ensuring seamless integration across trading, clearing, and settlement systems.

Achieved regulatory compliance by delivering accurate, timely reporting to the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), earning commendation from senior leadership for precision and reliability.

Financial Technologies India Ltd [Jan 2008 – Feb 2011]	Senior Executive BA

Financial Technologies (India) Ltd (FTIL), now known as 63 Moons Technologies, is a pioneering Indian fintech company that developed and operated electronic trading and clearing platforms across multiple asset classes, including equities, commodities, currencies, and bonds.

Partnered with business stakeholders and exchange operations teams to elicit, analyse, and document functional and system requirements, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory frameworks.

Configured and implemented exchange product features for MCX Stock Exchange, managing User Acceptance Testing (UAT), deployment coordination, and post-go-live stabilisation.

Delivered application and production support for major exchanges including Multi Commodity Exchange, MCX Stock Exchange, and Dubai Gold & Commodities Exchange, ensuring system reliability and uninterrupted trading operations.

Developed and standardised operational procedures and workflow documentation, improving process efficiency, governance, and audit readiness across exchange operations.

Produced regulatory and business intelligence reports using SAP BusinessObjects, collaborating with product development teams to recommend platform enhancements based on client and regulatory feedback.

Supported SWIFT payment integrations and version upgrades across trading and clearing applications, ensuring secure and compliant financial transaction processing.

Key Achievements

Successfully led the go live of the MCX-SX Currency Derivatives Exchange, ensuring seamless integration across trading, clearing, and settlement modules.

Received an official appreciation letter from the Dubai Gold & Commodity Exchange (DGCX) for successfully executing a major system and database migration, improving performance and business continuity.

Credence Analytics (I) Private Ltd [Dec 2006 – Jan 2008]	Assistant Consultant Software

Credence Analytics is a fintech company providing software and IT solutions for the banking, financial services, and insurance (BFSI) sector. The firm specialises in automating treasury operations, investment management, fund administration, investor servicing, and risk management.

Implemented the iDEAL Funds Treasury Management Solution, configuring asset classes, cash flow structures, and Value at Risk (VaR) calculations to meet financial and regulatory standards.

Led User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and functional validation, ensuring the delivered solution met business and technical requirements prior to production rollout.

Designed and executed validation rules, reconciliations, and exception reports to ensure accuracy and integrity of treasury data across trades, positions, exposures, and settlements.

Supported data migration and system configuration activities, collaborating closely with business users to ensure alignment with operational workflows and evolving business needs.

Delivered post implementation application support and end user training, promoting adoption and optimal use of the system.

Monitored application performance, managed defect tracking, and oversaw resolution processes to ensure high system availability and operational continuity.

Education

Post Graduate Diploma in Finance Management – Welingkar Institute of Management, Mumbai

Bachelor of Engineering (Computer Engineering) – University of Pune

Professional References

Key Achievements
Delivered critical EMIR compliance updates ahead of regulatory deadlines.
Recognised with the “Lead with Integrity and Accountability” award for excellence in cross-regional delivery and stakeholder collaboration.
Accenture [Jul 2014 – Jun 2018]	Team Lead Business Analyst
Accenture is a global professional services company specialising in digital, cloud, and security solutions, with a strong presence across Australia (Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Canberra, and Perth). It partners with clients in financial services, government, and energy sectors to drive digital transformation and innovation.
Partnered with Nippon Mutual Fund to elicit, document, and prioritise functional and non-functional requirements across multiple Agile initiatives.
Led end-to-end delivery of a B2B and B2C e-commerce portal and mobile onboarding solution, integrating REST APIs, digital KYC, payment gateway, and biometric authentication services.
Defined user roles, access controls, and data governance models within the Treasury Management System (TMS) to reduce operational risk and ensure regulatory compliance.
Facilitated stakeholder workshops, interviews, and process walkthroughs to validate business needs, map system dependencies, and align project objectives.
Authored detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and process documentation using Jira and Confluence, focusing on API integration requirements and data flows.
Developed current-state and future-state process models to identify bottlenecks and propose improvements aligned with customer experience and system interoperability.
Collaborated with UX/UI and security architects to ensure mobile applications adhered to user centric design principles and PCI DSS standards.
Partnered with third-party vendors (including FSS Payment Gateway) to define integration scope, manage REST API integrations, and oversee implementation.
Supported SEPA payment integration by analysing functional requirements, mapping payment workflows, and coordinating implementation with business and technology teams.
Performed impact analysis and UAT validation for SEPA and cross-border payment enhancements, ensuring seamless integration with Treasury Management System (TMS) and payment gateway platforms.
Key Achievements
Awarded Certificate of Excellence by Reliance Nippon Mutual Fund for delivering innovative digital solutions across mobile and web platforms.
Received “Star of the Month” at Accenture for outstanding contributions to a high-impact digital transformation program.
Key Achievements
Successfully delivered the end to end implementation and golive of SMX, ensuring seamless integration across trading, clearing, and settlement systems.
Achieved regulatory compliance by delivering accurate, timely reporting to the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), earning commendation from senior leadership for precision and reliability.
Key Achievements
Successfully led the go live of the MCX-SX Currency Derivatives Exchange, ensuring seamless integration across trading, clearing, and settlement modules.
Received an official appreciation letter from the Dubai Gold & Commodity Exchange (DGCX) for successfully executing a major system and database migration, improving performance and business continuity.
